secrets.custody/authored/a-prepared-batc.purpose: The prepared batch body the OpenAPI document omits is what commit applies.

secrets.custody/authored/a-put-with-a-25.purpose: A put whose key is exactly 255 ASCII characters is stored.

secrets.custody/authored/a-put-with-a-ke.purpose: A put whose key is 200 two-byte characters is 400 bytes and is refused as an invalid reference.

secrets.custody/authored/a-put-with-an-e.purpose: A put whose key is empty is refused as an invalid reference and stores nothing.

secrets.custody/authored/a-second-prepar.purpose: A transaction id prepared twice in one tenant is refused as a conflict, a response the OpenAPI document omits.

secrets.custody/authored/a-workload-dele.purpose: A workload delete names its reference in a body the OpenAPI document omits, and the secret leaves its namespace.

secrets.custody/authored/secret-metadata.purpose: Secret metadata carries created_at and updated_at, which the OpenAPI Metadata schema omits.
